sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A deciduous large shrub or small tree native to Japan. Its rounded leaves have 7–11 lobes and can reach about 20 cm; red-purple flower clusters appear in spring, followed by paired winged fruits. Garden references give a typical height of about 4–8 m and a spread of about 2.5–4 m.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: It is cultivated as an ornamental, especially for its foliage and autumn colour. The sources consulted do not establish food use or toxicity.
